# IllegalStateException

<link-summary>The call arrived at the wrong moment: the arguments may be perfectly valid, but the object is not in a state that allows it.</link-summary>

<web-summary>IllegalStateException — The call arrived at the wrong moment: the arguments may be perfectly valid, but the object is not in a state that allows it. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>exception</code> · Since: 1.11.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
class IllegalStateException extends RuntimeException
```

The call arrived at the wrong moment: the arguments may be perfectly valid, but the object is not in a state that allows it.

Thrown by [`requireState`](requireState.md).

Every class in this hierarchy takes an optional message, another exception whose message it reuses, or nothing at all. `isException` recognises all of them; a plain `Error` is not one.

## Examples

### Throwing and catching

```javascript
throw new IllegalStateException("something specific about this call");

try {
  doWork();
} catch (error) {
  if (error instanceof IllegalStateException) {
    // handled
  }
}
```
